title: J&K Congress and INDIA bloc protest in Srinagar against CEC and central leadership
seoTitle: Srinagar protest against CEC and vote theft

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against the treatment of national leaders in Delhi and alleged voter list fraud.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner and the Prime Minister and Union Home Minister.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Regional parties joined Congress-led protests at the party headquarters in Srinagar.

summary: Jammu and Kashmir political parties, including the Congress, National Conference, and Peoples Democratic Party, held demonstrations in Srinagar to protest against the treatment of national leaders in Delhi and alleged voter list fraud. Demonstrators gathered at the Congress party headquarters in Srinagar and attempted to carry out marches toward the main roads and Lal Chowk, but security forces and the CRPF blocked them from proceeding. Participants carried placards and shouted slogans targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Organisers demanded the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner and an inquiry into the election commission's functioning, while police and security forces prevented the processions from advancing.
organizers: Jammu and Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Inquiry into the functioning of CEC Kumar
Resignation of the Prime Minister and Union Home Minister
response: Police and CRPF personnel stopped the protesters from marching onto main roads and foiled their demonstration.

updates.text: JKPCC observed a black day and attempted a march from its Srinagar headquarters, which was foiled by police.
NC and PDP workers joined Congress-led protests in Srinagar, attempting a march toward Lal Chowk that was blocked by security forces.
